dhp21:1:
Heedfulness:
the path to the Deathless.
dhp21:4:
The heedless are as if
already dead.
dhp22:1: Knowing this as a true distinction,
dhp22:4: enjoying the range of the noble ones.
dhp23:1:
The enlightened, constantly
absorbed in jhana,
persevering,
dhp23:4:
the unexcelled rest
from the yoke.
dhp24:2:
clean in action,
acting with due consideration,
dhp25:3:
the wise would make
an island
dhp26:3:
while one who is wise
cherishes heedfulness
dhp27:2:
or to intimacy
with sensual delight–
dhp27:3:
for a heedful person,
absorbed in jhana,
dhp28:1:
When the wise person drives out
heedlessness
dhp28:3:
having climbed the high tower
of discernment,
dhp28:4:
sorrow-free,
he observes the sorrowing crowd–
dhp28:5:
as the enlightened man,
having scaled
a summit,
dhp28:6: the fools on the ground below.
dhp29:1:
Heedful among the heedless,
wakeful among those asleep,
dhp29:3:
just as a fast horse advances,
leaving the weak behind:
dhp32:4:
stands right on the verge
of Unbinding.
